     3:## 1. 背景与目标
     4:
     5:**适用对象**：Toybrick TB-RK3588SD，原厂系统为 Debian，RK3588 平台。
     6:
     7:**核心目标**：仅替换 SD 卡上的 rootfs 为 Ubuntu 22.04，保留原厂 U-Boot / 内核 / dtb / 启动链不变。上板后运行 ROS2 Humble，实现雷达建图、自主导航、行为树巡检。
     8:
     9:**为什么换 Ubuntu 22.04**：
    10:
    11:| 理由 | 说明 |
    12:|------|------|
    13:| ROS2 生态匹配 | Humble 官方二进制面向 Ubuntu 22.04 Jammy，apt 直接装 `ros-humble-*` |
    14:| 导航/SLAM 包最全 | nav2、slam_toolbox、behavior_tree、foxglove 等在 22.04 aarch64 上资料最多 |
    15:| Debian 维护成本高 | 官方 Foxy 已 EOL，源码编译/容器方案增加适配负担 |
    16:| 安全可控 | 换错只需重做 SD，原 Debian 系统通过拔卡恢复 |
    17:
    18:**为什么不直接刷整卡镜像**：通用 RK3588 Ubuntu 整包会覆盖 U-Boot/内核/dtb，与你"保留原厂启动链"的目标冲突。除非你打算完全重适配所有驱动（WiFi/蓝牙/NPU/ISP/串口），否则不要走这条路。
    19:
    20:## 2. 启动链与职责边界
    21:
    22:TB-RK3588SD 原厂启动大致流程：
    23:
    24:```
    25:SPI Flash (存 uboot) → boot 分区 (后续启动内容) → SD/TF 卡 (rootfs)
    26:```
    27:
    28:不同批次/固件可能不同，动手前先用串口看 U-Boot 输出，在原系统执行：
    29:
    30:```bash
    31:uname -a              # 内核版本
    32:lsblk                 # 各分区挂载关系
    33:cat /proc/cmdline     # 内核命令行，看 root= 指向哪
    34:```
    35:
    36:**本方案分工原则**：
    37:
    38:| 组件 | 位置 | 是否改动 |
    39:|------|------|---------|
    40:| U-Boot | SPI Flash | ❌ 不动 |
    41:| SPL / Miniloader | SPI / eMMC | ❌ 不动 |
    42:| 内核 Image | boot 分区 | ❌ 不动 |
    43:| dtb | boot 分区 / SPI / FIT | ❌ 不动 |
    44:| 内核模块 | rootfs `/lib/modules/$(uname -r)` | ✅ 从原 Debian 拷入 |
    45:| 固件 | rootfs `/lib/firmware` | ✅ 从原 Debian 拷入 |
    46:| 用户态系统 | SD rootfs | ✅ 替换为 Ubuntu 22.04 |
    47:
    48:> **关键约束**：新 rootfs 的内核模块版本必须与原厂运行内核版本完全一致。
    49:
    50:## 3. 在 x86 主机制作 arm64 rootfs
    51:
    52:### 3.1 环境准备
    53:
    54:物理 Ubuntu x86 或 WSL2 均可。WSL2 的 binfmt 偶尔异常，物理机更稳。
    55:
    56:```bash
    57:sudo apt update
    58:sudo apt install -y qemu-user-static binfmt-support debootstrap \
    59:  rsync squashfs-tools git
    60:```
    61:
    62:注册 aarch64 binfmt 解释器（**不注册会在 chroot 时报 Exec format error**）：
    63:
    64:```bash
    65:sudo update-binfmts --enable qemu-aarch64
    66:cat /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/qemu-aarch64
    67:# 应输出包含 interpreter /usr/bin/qemu-aarch64-static 的内容
    68:```
    69:
    70:### 3.2 下载 ubuntu-base
    71:
    72:官方目录：
    73:
    74:```
    75:https://cdimage.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-base/releases/22.04/release/
    76:```
    77:
    78:下载 arm64 基础包：
    79:
    80:```bash
    81:wget https://cdimage.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-base/releases/22.04/release/ubuntu-base-22.04.5-base-arm64.tar.gz
    82:```
    83:
    84:国内镜像加速（替换域名即可）：
    85:
    86:- `https://mirrors.bfsu.edu.cn/ubuntu-cdimage/ubuntu-base/releases/22.04/release/`
    87:- `https://mirrors.aliyun.com/ubuntu-cdimage/ubuntu-base/releases/22.04/release/`
    88:- `https://mirrors.ustc.edu.cn/ubuntu-cdimage/ubuntu-base/releases/22.04/release/`
    89:
    90:### 3.3 解包与注入 qemu
    91:
    92:```bash
    93:mkdir -p ~/tb3588/rootfs
    94:tar -xzf ubuntu-base-22.04.5-base-arm64.tar.gz -C ~/tb3588/rootfs
    95:cp /usr/bin/qemu-aarch64-static ~/tb3588/rootfs/usr/bin/
    96:```
    97:
    98:### 3.4 chroot 初始化基础系统
    99:
   100:```bash
   101:cat > ~/tb3588/chroot_init.sh <<'EOF'
   102:#!/bin/bash
   103:R=~/tb3588/rootfs
   104:
   105:# 挂载虚拟文件系统
   106:mount -t proc proc $R/proc
   107:mount -t sysfs sys $R/sys
   108:mount -o bind /dev $R/dev
   109:mount -o bind /dev/pts $R/dev/pts
   110:
   111:# chroot 内安装基础包
   112:chroot $R /bin/bash -c '
   113:export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
   114:apt update || true
   115:apt install -y locales tzdata sudo openssh-server systemd udev dbus \
   116:  netplan.io ifupdown iproute2 resolvconf psmisc vim nano \
   117:  ca-certificates wget curl gnupg lsb-release htop i2c-tools
   118:locale-gen en_US.UTF-8
   119:ln -sf /usr/share/zoneinfo/Asia/Shanghai /etc/localtime
   120:'
   121:
   122:# 卸载
   123:umount -R $R/proc 2>/dev/null
   124:umount -R $R/sys 2>/dev/null
   125:umount $R/dev/pts 2>/dev/null
   126:umount $R/dev 2>/dev/null
   127:EOF
   128:
   129:bash ~/tb3588/chroot_init.sh
   130:```
   131:
   132:### 3.5 使用 carrot-ubuntu 脚本（备选）
   133:
   134:如果你已用 carrot-ubuntu 脚本：
   135:
   136:```bash
   137:cd carrot-ubuntu
   138:sudo ./make_ubuntu_rootfs.sh
   139:# 选 1) 22.04/Jammy
   140:# 选 2) server
   141:```
   142:
   143:**前置条件**：确保 `qemu-user-static` + `binfmt-support` 已装，否则报 `Exec format error`。
   144:
   145:**注意**：脚本产物若含内核/boot/dtb，按"原厂启动链优先"原则剔除，只取 rootfs 内容。
   146:
   147:## 4. 拷贝原厂驱动与规则
   148:
   149:在原 Debian 系统上执行，打包后解到新 rootfs：
   150:
   151:```bash
   152:# 原系统执行
   153:KVER=$(uname -r)
   154:
   155:mkdir -p /tmp/oldroot/lib/modules
   156:cp -a /lib/modules/$KVER /tmp/oldroot/lib/modules/
   157:
   158:cp -a /lib/firmware /tmp/oldroot/firmware
   159:
   160:mkdir -p /tmp/oldroot/etc/udev
   161:cp -a /etc/udev/rules.d /tmp/oldroot/etc/udev/rules.d.orig
   162:
   163:# 网络配置
   164:cp -a /etc/network /tmp/oldroot/etc/ 2>/dev/null
   165:cp -a /etc/netplan /tmp/oldroot/etc/ 2>/dev/null
   166:
   167:# 打包
   168:tar -czf /tmp/toybrick_drivers.tar.gz -C /tmp/oldroot lib etc
   169:```
   170:
   171:拷到主机后，解压到新 rootfs：
   172:
   173:```bash
   174:sudo tar -xzf toybrick_drivers.tar.gz -C ~/tb3588/rootfs/
   175:```
   176:
   177:**Toybrick 特有包**：如 `toybrick-prop`、`vendor-firmware`、`toybrick-server`、NPU/MPP/RGA/ISP 相关包，按原系统 `dpkg -l | grep toybrick` 列出清单，逐一迁移到新 rootfs。
   178:
   179:## 5. SD 卡制作
   180:
   181:### 5.1 分区
   182:
   183:SD 卡用 GPT 分区表，根分区 ext4。分区大小建议 30-40GB（64GB SD 可用约 58-60GB）。
   184:
   185:```bash
   186:# 假设 SD 设备为 /dev/sdX，请确认后再操作！
   187:sudo parted /dev/sdX mklabel gpt
   188:sudo parted /dev/sdX mkpart primary ext4 0% 100%
   189:sudo mkfs.ext4 /dev/sdX1
   190:```
   191:
   192:### 5.2 写入 rootfs
   193:
   194:```bash
   195:sudo mkdir -p /mnt/sdroot
   196:sudo mount /dev/sdX1 /mnt/sdroot
   197:
   198:# 用 rsync 保留权限
   199:sudo rsync -axHAX --numeric-ids ~/tb3588/rootfs/ /mnt/sdroot/
   200:
   201:sudo umount /mnt/sdroot
   202:```
   203:
   204:### 5.3 配置 fstab
   205:
   206:```bash
   207:sudo mount /dev/sdX1 /mnt/sdroot
   208:blkid /dev/sdX1   # 获取 UUID
   209:```
   210:
   211:编辑 `/mnt/sdroot/etc/fstab`：
   212:
   213:```
   214:UUID=xxxx-xxxx / ext4 defaults,noatime 0 1
   215:```
   216:
   217:> 不要挂载不存在的 `/boot/efi`，除非你确认启动链需要。
   218:
   219:### 5.4 串口固定名
   220:
   221:用 `lsusb` 和 `udevadm info` 获取雷达/底盘的 USB 串口适配器属性，创建规则：
   222:
   223:```bash
   224:sudo nano /mnt/sdroot/etc/udev/rules.d/99-robot-serial.rules
   225:```
   226:
   227:内容示例：
   228:
   229:```
   230:# RPLIDAR A1
   231:SUBSYSTEM=="tty", ATTRS{idVendor}=="10c4", ATTRS{idProduct}=="ea60", SYMLINK+="lidar"
   232:
   233:# 底盘串口
   234:SUBSYSTEM=="tty", ATTRS{idVendor}=="1a86", ATTRS{idProduct}=="7523", SYMLINK+="chassis"
   235:```
   236:
   237:### 5.5 账号与 SSH
   238:
   239:chroot 或上板后：
   240:
   241:```bash
   242:# 建用户
   243:adduser robot
   244:usermod -aG sudo robot
   245:
   246:# 允许 SSH root 登录（调试阶段，正式部署建议禁用）
   247:sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
   248:systemctl enable ssh
   249:```
   250:
   251:卸载：
   252:
   253:```bash
   254:sudo umount /mnt/sdroot
   255:```
   256:
   257:## 6. 上板首次启动核查
   258:
   259:插 SD 卡，从原 Debian 正常关机后插入 TF 卡，再上电（TB-RK3588SD 资料提示"预装 rootfs 的 TF 卡不支持热插拔"）。
   260:
   261:串口看 U-Boot 输出，确认仍按原厂加载内核/dtb。
   262:
   263:进系统后执行：
   264:
   265:```bash
   266:uname -a                        # 内核版本与原厂一致
   267:ls /lib/modules/$(uname -r)     # 非空
   268:find /lib/firmware -maxdepth 1 | head   # 含原厂固件
   269:systemctl status systemd-udevd ssh      # 正常
   270:ip a                             # 网络
   271:ls /dev/ttyUSB*                  # 串口识别
   272:ls -l /dev/lidar /dev/chassis    # udev 别名
   273:dmesg | egrep -i 'usb|lidar|motor|panic|error'
   274:```
   275:
   276:**排查清单**：
   277:
   278:| 现象 | 可能原因 | 解决 |
   279:|------|---------|------|
   280:| 未从 SD 启动 | fstab UUID 错误/分区格式不对 | 检查 blkid 与 fstab |
   281:| 无网络 | modules/firmware 未拷全 | 重新拷 /lib/modules 和 /lib/firmware |
   282:| 串口不识别 | udev 规则未生效 | udevadm control --reload && trigger |
   283:| 内核模块报错 | 版本不匹配 | 确认 uname -r 与 modules 目录名一致 |
   284:
   285:## 7. ROS2 Humble 安装
   286:
   287:```bash
   288:sudo apt update
   289:sudo apt install -y software-properties-common
   290:sudo add-apt-repository universe
   291:sudo apt update
   292:
   293:# 添加 ROS2 apt 源
   294:sudo curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ros/rosdistro/master/ros.key \
   295:  -o /usr/share/keyrings/ros-archive-keyring.gpg
   296:
   297:echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/ros-archive-keyring.gpg] \
   298:http://packages.ros.org/ros2/ubuntu $(. /etc/os-release && echo $UBUNTU_CODENAME) main" \
   299:| sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ros2.list
   300:
   301:sudo apt update
   302:
   303:# 安装 ros-base（不装 desktop，车端不需要图形）
   304:sudo apt install -y ros-humble-ros-base
   305:
   306:# 导航与 SLAM
   307:sudo apt install -y ros-humble-navigation2 ros-humble-nav2-bringup \
   308:  ros-humble-slam-toolbox ros-humble-map-server \
   309:  ros-humble-robot-localization
   310:
   311:# 雷达驱动（按型号选）
   312:sudo apt install -y ros-humble-rplidar-ros
   313:
   314:# 差速控制器
   315:sudo apt install -y ros-humble-diff-drive-controller \
   316:  ros-humble-controller-manager
   317:
   318:# 构建工具
   319:sudo apt install -y python3-colcon-common-extensions python3-rosdep
   320:```
   321:
   322:**空间占用参考**（apt 安装后）：
   323:
   324:| 组件 | 大小 |
   325:|------|------|
   326:| Ubuntu 22.04 server base | 2-5 GB |
   327:| ros-humble-ros-base | 1-2 GB |
   328:| nav2 + slam_toolbox + 依赖 | 2-4 GB |
   329:| 雷达/底盘驱动 | < 100 MB |
   330:| **合计** | **约 8-12 GB** |
   331:
   332:64GB SD 装完留 40GB+ 空闲，足够日志、rosbag、地图。
   333:
   334:## 8. 常见坑与注意事项
   335:
   336:| 坑 | 原因 | 对策 |
   337:|---|---|---|
   338:| chroot 报 `Exec format error` | 未注册 qemu-aarch64 binfmt | `sudo update-binfmts --enable qemu-aarch64` |
   339:| 模块版本不匹配 | 新 rootfs 内核版本 ≠ 原厂 | `uname -r` 必须等于 `lib/modules/` 目录名 |
   340:| SD 卡损坏 | rosbag/日志高频写 | logrotate + 限制 bag 数量 + 重要数据另存 |
   341:| 串口名漂移 | 未写 udev 规则 | 用 idVendor/idProduct 固定别名 |
   342:| 换 rootfs 后驱动异常 | 误带新内核到 rootfs | rootfs 不放内核/boot/dtb |
   343:| 中文构建路径 | 脚本 chroot/mount 异常 | 工作目录用纯英文 |
   344:| WSL2 binfmt 抽风 | WSL 的 binfmt_misc 行为异常 | 改用物理 Ubuntu 或 Docker |
   345:| 整包镜像覆盖启动链 | 用了通用 RK3588 整卡镜像 | 只用 rootfs tar，不刷 U-Boot/内核/dtb |
   346:
   347:## 9. 后续路线
   348:
   349:完成 rootfs 替换和 ROS2 安装后，按此顺序推进：
   350:
   351:1. **底盘驱动**：串口通信、PID 速度控制、/cmd_vel → /odom ✅
   352:2. **雷达驱动**：rplidar_ros 跑通，RViz 看 /scan ✅
   353:3. **建图**：slam_toolbox 在线建图，保存 .pgm/.yaml ✅
   354:4. **导航**：nav2 单点导航 + 避障 + 恢复行为 ✅
   355:5. **行为树**：多航点巡检、异常检测与记录 ✅
   356:6. **自治**：自启动、电池监控、低电回充、看门狗 ✅
   357:7. **林业应用**：火情/病树/入侵检测、语义地图、多机协同 ✅

   147:## 4. 拷贝原厂驱动与规则
   148:
   149:在原 Debian 系统上执行，打包后解到新 rootfs：
   150:
   151:```bash
   152:# 原系统执行
   153:KVER=$(uname -r)
   154:
   155:mkdir -p /tmp/oldroot/lib/modules
   156:cp -a /lib/modules/$KVER /tmp/oldroot/lib/modules/
   157:
   158:cp -a /lib/firmware /tmp/oldroot/firmware
   159:
   160:mkdir -p /tmp/oldroot/etc/udev
   161:cp -a /etc/udev/rules.d /tmp/oldroot/etc/udev/rules.d.orig
   162:
   163:# 网络配置
   164:cp -a /etc/network /tmp/oldroot/etc/ 2>/dev/null
   165:cp -a /etc/netplan /tmp/oldroot/etc/ 2>/dev/null
   166:
   167:# 打包
   168:tar -czf /tmp/toybrick_drivers.tar.gz -C /tmp/oldroot lib etc
   169:```

   171:拷到主机后，解压到新 rootfs：
   172:
   173:```bash
   174:sudo tar -xzf toybrick_drivers.tar.gz -C ~/tb3588/rootfs/
   175:```

   179:## 5. SD 卡制作
   180:
   181:### 5.1 分区
   182:
   183:SD 卡用 GPT 分区表，根分区 ext4。分区大小建议 30-40GB（64GB SD 可用约 58-60GB）。
   184:
   185:```bash
   186:# 假设 SD 设备为 /dev/sdX，请确认后再操作！
   187:sudo parted /dev/sdX mklabel gpt
   188:sudo parted /dev/sdX mkpart primary ext4 0% 100%
   189:sudo mkfs.ext4 /dev/sdX1
   190:```
   191:
   192:### 5.2 写入 rootfs
   193:
   194:```bash
   195:sudo mkdir -p /mnt/sdroot
   196:sudo mount /dev/sdX1 /mnt/sdroot
   197:
   198:# 用 rsync 保留权限
   199:sudo rsync -axHAX --numeric-ids ~/tb3588/rootfs/ /mnt/sdroot/
   200:
   201:sudo umount /mnt/sdroot
   202:```
   203:
   204:### 5.3 配置 fstab
   205:
   206:```bash
   207:sudo mount /dev/sdX1 /mnt/sdroot
   208:blkid /dev/sdX1   # 获取 UUID
   209:```
   210:
   211:编辑 `/mnt/sdroot/etc/fstab`：
   212:
   213:```
   214:UUID=xxxx-xxxx / ext4 defaults,noatime 0 1
   215:```

   217:> 不要挂载不存在的 `/boot/efi`，除非你确认启动链需要。

   221:用 `lsusb` 和 `udevadm info` 获取雷达/底盘的 USB 串口适配器属性，创建规则：
   222:
   223:```bash
   224:sudo nano /mnt/sdroot/etc/udev/rules.d/99-robot-serial.rules
   225:```
   226:
   227:内容示例：
   228:
   229:```
   230:# RPLIDAR A1
   231:SUBSYSTEM=="tty", ATTRS{idVendor}=="10c4", ATTRS{idProduct}=="ea60", SYMLINK+="lidar"
   232:
   233:# 底盘串口
   234:SUBSYSTEM=="tty", ATTRS{idVendor}=="1a86", ATTRS{idProduct}=="7523", SYMLINK+="chassis"
   235:```
   236:
   237:### 5.5 账号与 SSH
   238:
   239:chroot 或上板后：
   240:
   241:```bash
   242:# 建用户
   243:adduser robot
   244:usermod -aG sudo robot
   245:
   246:# 允许 SSH root 登录（调试阶段，正式部署建议禁用）
   247:sed -i 's/#PermitRootLogin prohibit-password/PermitRootLogin yes/' /etc/ssh/sshd_config
   248:systemctl enable ssh
   249:```
   250:
   251:卸载：
   252:
   253:```bash
   254:sudo umount /mnt/sdroot
   255:```
   256:
   257:## 6. 上板首次启动核查
   258:
   259:插 SD 卡，从原 Debian 正常关机后插入 TF 卡，再上电（TB-RK3588SD 资料提示"预装 rootfs 的 TF 卡不支持热插拔"）。
   260:
   261:串口看 U-Boot 输出，确认仍按原厂加载内核/dtb。
   262:
   263:进系统后执行：
   264:
   265:```bash
   266:uname -a                        # 内核版本与原厂一致
   267:ls /lib/modules/$(uname -r)     # 非空
   268:find /lib/firmware -maxdepth 1 | head   # 含原厂固件
   269:systemctl status systemd-udevd ssh      # 正常
   270:ip a                             # 网络
   271:ls /dev/ttyUSB*                  # 串口识别
   272:ls -l /dev/lidar /dev/chassis    # udev 别名
   273:dmesg | egrep -i 'usb|lidar|motor|panic|error'
   274:```

   276:**排查清单**：
   277:
   278:| 现象 | 可能原因 | 解决 |
   279:|------|---------|------|

   285:## 7. ROS2 Humble 安装
   286:
   287:```bash

   289:sudo apt install -y software-properties-common
   290:sudo add-apt-repository universe
   291:sudo apt update
   292:

   294:sudo curl -sSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ros/rosdistro/master/ros.key \
   295:  -o /usr/share/keyrings/ros-archive-keyring.gpg
   296:
   297:echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/usr/share/keyrings/ros-archive-keyring.gpg] \

   299:| sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/ros2.list
   300:
   301:sudo apt update
   302:
   303:# 安装 ros-base（不装 desktop，车端不需要图形）
   304:sudo apt install -y ros-humble-ros-base
   305:
   306:# 导航与 SLAM
   307:sudo apt install -y ros-humble-navigation2 ros-humble-nav2-bringup \
   308:  ros-humble-slam-toolbox ros-humble-map-server \
   309:  ros-humble-robot-localization
   310:
   311:# 雷达驱动（按型号选）
   312:sudo apt install -y ros-humble-rplidar-ros
   313:
   314:# 差速控制器
   315:sudo apt install -y ros-humble-diff-drive-controller \
   316:  ros-humble-controller-manager
   317:
   318:# 构建工具
   319:sudo apt install -y python3-colcon-common-extensions python3-rosdep
   320:```

   326:| Ubuntu 22.04 server base | 2-5 GB |
   327:| ros-humble-ros-base | 1-2 GB |
   328:| nav2 + slam_toolbox + 依赖 | 2-4 GB |

   334:## 8. 常见坑与注意事项
   335:
   336:| 坑 | 原因 | 对策 |
   337:|---|---|---|
   338:| chroot 报 `Exec format error` | 未注册 qemu-aarch64 binfmt | `sudo update-binfmts --enable qemu-aarch64` |
   339:| 模块版本不匹配 | 新 rootfs 内核版本 ≠ 原厂 | `uname -r` 必须等于 `lib/modules/` 目录名 |

现系统 `/proc/cmdline` 写的是 `root=/dev/mmcblk1p2`，但实际跑在 **`mmcblk1p1`** 上——两者不一致说明"根分区是谁"另有出处（U-Boot 环境变量 / FIT bootargs / 分区 UUID 等）。**新卡的布局必须照它来**，否则会出现"能进 U-Boot、找不到根分区"。

```bash
# ① 在现系统上（只读）

cat /etc/fstab                      # 看 / 是按设备名还是 UUID 挂的
lsblk -f
blkid

# ② 串口接 U-Boot，按复位键，在倒计时结束前按键停下，执行：
printenv bootargs
printenv bootcmd
part list mmc 1                     # 看 U-Boot 眼里的 SD 分区表
```

> **建议**：新卡先按**与现卡完全一致的布局**做（单分区 ext4 占满 + `fstab` 用 UUID 或设备名，与现卡一致）；

## 3. 制作 arm64 rootfs：先选路线

| | **方案 A：在板子上直接做（native，推荐）** | **方案 B：x86 主机 + qemu（本文档原流程）** |
|---|---|---|
| 前提 | 板子能装 `debootstrap`（Debian 源可用 ✅）、有 **USB 读卡器**把新卡插上去；或先做成目录再拷走 | 一台 x86 Ubuntu（或 WSL2）+ 网络下载 `ubuntu-base` |
| 同构性 | arm64 → arm64，**不需要 qemu** | 需要 `qemu-user-static` + binfmt |
| 速度 | 快（原生执行） | 慢（模拟执行） |
| 命令 | `sudo apt install debootstrap` → `sudo debootstrap --arch=arm64 jammy /mnt/newroot http://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports` | §3.1~3.5 |

> 两条路线的**后续步骤完全一样**（§4 拷驱动 → §5 写卡 → §6 上板核查 → §7 装 ROS2）。
> 选哪条取决于"手上有没有 x86 机器 / USB 读卡器"——板内路线少了 qemu 这一层坑。

**方案 A 具体流程**（新卡插在读卡器上，假设识别为 `/dev/sdX`）：

```bash
sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y debootstrap rsync

# ① 分区 + 格式化（布局见 §5.1，先按现卡单分区做）
sudo parted /dev/sdX mklabel gpt
sudo parted /dev/sdX mkpart primary ext4 0% 100%
sudo mkfs.ext4 /dev/sdX1

# ② 原生 debootstrap 到新卡（arm64→arm64，无 qemu）
sudo mkdir -p /mnt/newroot && sudo mount /dev/sdX1 /mnt/newroot
sudo debootstrap --arch=arm64 jammy /mnt/newroot http://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports

# ③ 之后所有配置都在这个目录里做（chroot 是原生的，不需要 qemu-aarch64-static）
sudo cp /etc/resolv.conf /mnt/newroot/etc/     # 让 chroot 里能解析域名
sudo mount -t proc proc /mnt/newroot/proc
sudo mount -t sysfs sys /mnt/newroot/sys
sudo mount -o bind /dev /mnt/newroot/dev
sudo chroot /mnt/newroot /bin/bash
#   → 里面继续 §3.4 的 apt 安装清单
```

> 板内路线没有"下载 ubuntu-base tar 包"这一步，debootstrap 直接按 jammy 的包列表装。

## 3'. 在 x86 主机制作 arm64 rootfs（方案 B）
```

I need to explain clearly, in plain language, the difference between:
- 方案 A: build the Ubuntu rootfs **on the board itself** (because the board is arm64, and Ubuntu 22.04 arm64 is the same architecture → no emulation needed). The new SD card is connected to the board via a USB card reader, and debootstrap writes the Ubuntu system directly onto it.
- 方案 B: build on an x86 PC using qemu-aarch64 emulation, because x86 can't natively run arm64 binaries.

Key explanation points:
1. 换系统这件事 = 准备一份 Ubuntu 的文件树（/bin /etc /usr ...），不是"装系统"那种一步步点。
2. 电脑的 CPU 架构（x86 vs arm64）决定"能不能直接执行这些程序"：板子是 arm64，Ubuntu arm64 的包也是 arm64 → **同一架构，能直接跑**，所以可以直接在板子上生成这套文件，写进新卡。
3. 之前文档写的是"在 x86 电脑上做"，x86 不能跑 arm64 程序 → 需要 qemu 模拟（binfmt 注册），装包时每个程序都被"翻译"执行，慢且容易出怪错（Exec format error 等）。
4. 方案 A 的前提：板子上要能装 debootstrap（实测可装 ✓，Debian 源可用）+ 把新卡插到板子上需要 **USB 读卡器**。
5. 特别说明：板子自己正在从旧卡运行，新卡是**另一个设备**——所以不是"给自己换系统"，而是"给另一张卡准备系统"，不会影响正在跑的旧卡 ✓（这点可能正是让他困惑的地方：在板子上做，会不会把我现在的系统搞坏？答：不会，全程只往外接的那张新卡/目录里写，旧卡一个字节都不动）。
6. 流程图对比（ASCII）会很有帮助。
7. 也解释一下"native"的意思：原生执行 = 不经过翻译/模拟。

Also clarify the third possibility: 板内 debootstrap 到目录 → tar 出来 → 用别的电脑写卡（没有读卡器时的变通）。

Let me also make the explanation concrete with the actual commands explained line by line:
- `debootstrap --arch=arm64 jammy /mnt/newroot http://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports`：
  - debootstrap = 官方工具，"拉包裹的脚手架"，它把 jammy（22.04）的最小系统装到 `/mnt/newroot` 这个目录里，不是在"安装到当前系统"
  - `/mnt/newroot` 就是把新卡挂载到这里的目录 → 所有东西都写在新卡上

{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"reasoning","text":"The user says: "我手上有读卡器" (I have a card reader). So they'll go with 方案 A (board-internal native debootstrap).

They haven't answered the U-Boot question yet. So the next step: I should prepare the concrete commands for 方案 A — specifically:

1. **阶段 0 备份**: package the drivers/firmware/udev/network + robotcode + bash_aliases. I can *prepare the commands* for them to run (they require sudo). Should I run them? The backup commands write to /tmp (safe, in-workspace-ish) but involve `sudo` (for /lib/modules, /lib/firmware, /etc). Running sudo may prompt for a password → can't (non-interactive). Hmm. The user is at the board; I could give them the commands to run themselves. But maybe I can do the non-sudo parts (tar ~/RobotCode, cp .bash_aliases) myself ✓.

Actually, better plan: **write a one-shot script** that does 阶段 0 (backup packaging) + prints the readiness check, then let the user run it with sudo. And also give them the exact 方案 A command sequence (阶段 1) with the device-name safety check.

Hmm, but the user said earlier "不要动代码" for the doc reading; then they told me to modify the doc. Writing a helper script = creating a new file. Is that welcome? They said "按照你的建议来改" for the doc. Now they just say they have a card reader. The natural next step is: "then let's do 方案 A — here are the exact commands; first, plug in the reader and the new card, show me lsblk output".

I think the best response:
1. Confirm: 走方案 A ✓
2. Give the concrete step-by-step for 阶段 0 (backup) — and ask them to run the sudo-needed parts, OR do the non-sudo parts myself now.
3. Tell them exactly what to plug in and what command to run to show me the device (`lsblk`), so I can verify from their output before we format anything (safety!).
4. Remind about the U-Boot bootargs check (needed before creating partitions) — but note: we can do the backup + rootfs build first, and decide the partition layout at the last step (writing to the card). Actually the partition decision matters only when formatting/writing the card. debootstrap writes into a mounted partition... So we DO need the layout before debootstrap (if p2 is needed, we must create p2 first). Hmm: with 方案 A, the flow is: partition+format the new card → mount → debootstrap. So the layout decision comes early. But we could: (a) do backup now; (b) check U-Boot; (c) then partition.

Alternative clever approach: debootstrap into a **directory on the board** (~/tb3588/rootfs) first — no card involvement, no layout decision needed — and only later rsync it onto the new card with whatever layout U-Boot needs. That decouples the steps and is safer (also lets us verify the tree before touching the card). The board has 41 G free ✓ (base system ~2-5 GB, plus ROS 8-12 GB → ~15 GB; that fits in 41 GB ✓ but leaves less room; fine).

Hmm, but then the "rsync to card" step needs the card anyway ✓ that's fine.

Which is better for the user? 
- Path A1 (direct to card): needs the layout decided first (U-Boot info), and any mistake means re-doing on the card (slow, card wear).
- Path A2 (build in ~/tb3588/rootfs, then rsync to card): decouples, easier to iterate, and the card write is a simple rsync ✓ Also if the first boot fails, we can fix the directory and re-rsync quickly ✓ I'd recommend A2 as the practical flow. And it doesn't require a card reader until the final step!

That's a genuinely better plan: **先在板内把 Ubuntu 装到一个目录里（不碰卡），验证这棵树齐全（内核模块/固件/规则/专有包），再 rsync 到新卡**。

So my response: 
1. 走方案 A，但推荐**分两小步**：先做"目录版"（不碰卡）→ 再 rsync 到新卡。理由：不用等 U-Boot 信息、不怕格错卡、出错重来成本低。
2. 现在就能开始的两件事：
   a. **阶段 0 备份**（我可以现在跑非 sudo 部分；sudo 部分给你命令）
   b. 装 debootstrap（需要 sudo：`sudo apt install -y debootstrap rsync`）
3. 给出具体命令序列（阶段 0 + 目录版 debootstrap），并说明大约耗时/空间。
4. 让他把 `lsblk` 输出/串口 bootargs 结果发我，用于最后的写卡步骤。

Should I run the backup myself? The non-sudo parts: tar ~/RobotCode → that's 15 GB? Hmm! `~/RobotCode` size: df said 15 G used total on the card (that includes everything). /home/toybrick/RobotCode — earlier I saw logs (small), 04_map (~17 MB PNGs + the big posegraph), ros2_ws with build/install dirs... Hmm, RobotCode might be several GB. Where would I put the tar? On the same card (space is fine, 41 G free) ✓ but it's a 2-3 GB tar; fine.

Actually, for a backup, better: use rsync to a directory (not tar) so we can compare/incrementally re-run: `rsync -a ~/RobotCode/ /home/toybrick/backup/tb-backup/RobotCode/` hmm, but that doubles space. A tar is fine too.

Hmm — do I even need to copy ~/RobotCode? Alternative: **rsync ~/RobotCode directly from the old card to the new card** at the end (no intermediate copy) ✓ saves space/time. But if the new card fails, the old card still has everything ✓ (the old card is the backup!). So a full copy isn't strictly needed... except: the doc's §10 阶段 0 says to back up. Rationale: the old card stays intact anyway (dual-card), so a separate backup is mainly for "if the old card dies mid-process" (unlikely) or for insurance. I'd say: **不必现在整盘克隆**（旧卡本身就是保险），只需要把"系统级的小东西"打包（模块/固件/规则/网络/专有包 → 几十 MB~几百 MB）✓ 这个可以现在就做，很小。

Hmm, but /lib/firmware + /lib/modules/5.10.160: how big? Probably 100-500 MB. Fine.

So plan for this turn:
1. Explain: 走方案 A，建议"先目录版、后写卡"。
2. Do now (no sudo needed? /lib/modules, /lib/firmware, /etc require root to read? Reading is usually fine (world-readable) ✓ but /etc/wpa_supplicant may be root-only (600) → the tarball would need sudo. Let me check: I can read some as the user; if permission fails, need sudo.)
   - Hmm, `tar -czf` of /etc/udev/rules.d ✓ readable ✓; /etc/network ✓; /etc/netplan ✓ (maybe root-only); /etc/wpa_supplicant (dir listing showed 755 but wpa_supplicant.conf is 600 root) → need sudo for that file.
   So: give them the sudo one-liner (the doc's §4 block) rather than running it myself.
3. Ask them to run: `sudo apt install -y debootstrap rsync` and the §4 packaging, then show me the results (`ls -l /tmp/toybrick_drivers.tar.gz` and `ls -l /tmp/robotcode.tar.gz`).
4. Give the **目录版 debootstrap** command sequence to start (running in the background, ~30-60 min):
   ```
   sudo mkdir -p /home/toybrick/tb3588/rootfs
   sudo debootstrap --arch=arm64 jammy /home/toybrick/tb3588/rootfs http://ports.ubuntu.com/ubuntu-ports
   ```
   Hmm: debootstrap needs an empty target dir ✓; and needs network ✓ (WiFi up ✓). Also `--include=` could speed up. Also should we use a mirror (tuna) for speed? `http://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/ubuntu-ports/` ✓ they use tuna for Debian ✓ so recommend tuna for ubuntu-ports ✓ (faster in China).✓ Good practical tip.
   
   Note: on the board, is `apt install debootstrap` OK given the sources are Debian bullseye (including tuna mirror) ✓.

5. Ask for: ① `lsblk` (after plugging the reader + new card) ② U-Boot `printenv bootargs`.

Should I actually run the `sudo apt install debootstrap`? It needs a password → the execute_command tool would hang/fail. Better to hand the command to the user. But hmm, maybe sudo is passwordless on this board? Let me check `sudo -n true` (non-interactive test) — that's a read-only check ✓ quick. If passwordless, I could install debootstrap myself ✓ useful. Let me check that and the sizes.

Let me run a small read-only/safe command:
- `sudo -n true && echo 'sudo 免密可用' || echo 'sudo 需要密码'`
- `du -sh /lib/modules/5.10.160 /lib/firmware /home/toybrick/RobotCode 2>/dev/null | tail -5`
- `ls -l /etc/wpa_supplicant/wpa_supplicant.conf 2>&1` (permission check)
- `cat /etc/netplan/*.yaml 2>&1 | head -20` (to know the network config; may fail with permission)

This informs the plan. Let me run it (read-only + `sudo -n true` which is harmless).

Then respond with the concrete plan + commands.

mount -t proc proc $R/proc || exit 1
mount -t sysfs sys $R/sys
mount -o bind /dev $R/dev

chroot $R /bin/bash -c '
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive LANG=C.UTF-8
echo "Asia/Shanghai" > /etc/timezone
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y locales tzdata sudo openssh-server systemd udev dbus \
  network-manager wpasupplicant ifupdown iproute2 resolvconf psmisc vim nano \
  ca-certificates wget curl gnupg lsb-release htop i2c-tools python3 python3-pip \
  python3-numpy python3-opencv python3-serial rsync usbutils pciutils net-tools
locale-gen en_US.UTF-8
ln -sf /usr/share/zoneinfo/Asia/Shanghai /etc/localtime
groupadd -g 1000 toybrick 2>/dev/null
useradd -m -u 1000 -g 1000 -G sudo,dialout -s /bin/bash toybrick 2>/dev/null
systemctl enable ssh NetworkManager 2>/dev/null
'
echo "=== chroot 阶段完成 ==="
# 保留原系统的密码哈希
python3 -c "
base='/home/toybrick/tb3588/rootfs'
old={}
for l in open('/etc/shadow'):
    old[l.split(':')[0]]=l.rstrip('\n')
lines=open(base+'/etc/shadow').read().splitlines()
out=[old.get(l.split(':')[0], l) for l in lines]
open(base+'/etc/shadow','w').write('\n'.join(out)+'\n')
print('密码哈希已同步（root + toybrick）')
"
# 启用单元（兜底）
for u in ssh NetworkManager; do
  mkdir -p $R/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants
  ln -sf /lib/systemd/system/$u.service $R/etc/systemd/system/multi-user.target.wants/$u.service
done
umount -R $R/proc; umount -R $R/sys; umount $R/dev/pts; umount $R/dev
du -sh $R
echo "=== 全部完成 ==="
```
